versions.content: The Communication Management shall define how language specific data types are derived from modeled data types. Status: DRAFT Description: The Communication Management shall define how language specific data types, e.g. C++ data types, are derived from modeled data types. Rationale: The Communication Management shall support different language bindings. Dependencies: – Use Case: The Communication Management supports C++ language binding and therefore has to define the modeled data types in C++. Supporting Material: –
